It contains not less than 0.3% of flavonoids, expressed as hypero- side (C21H20O12 = 464.4) calculated with reference to the dried drug. Protect from light. Profile Knotgrass, Polygonum aviculare (P. heterophyllum) (Polygo- naceae), is included in herbal preparations for mild catarrh and associated upper respiratory-tract disorders. Homoeopathy. Knotgrass has been used in homoeopathic medicines under the following names: Polygonum aviculare. It was stated to be obtained from the blood of horses previously injected with an extract of Actinomyces bovis. Kveim Antigen Antígeno de Kveim. Profile Kveim antigen is a fine suspension in physiological saline of sar- coid tissue prepared from spleens taken from patients with active sarcoidosis. It is used as an intradermal injection in the Kveim (Kveim-Siltzbach) test for the diagnosis of sarcoidosis (p.1512). ◊ References. 1. James DG, Williams WJ. Kveim-Siltzbach test revisited. Sar- coidosis 1991; 8: 6–9. ◊ The safety of the Kveim test has been questioned, particularly with reference to the risk of transmission of sarcoidosis, and of hepatitis B, HIV, and Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease.
